hooks.command: if [ "${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-}" = true ] && [ "$(uname)" = Linux ] && [ ! -e /tmp/fetch_third_party.log ] && { [ ! -e third_party/wine/dlls/ntdll/tests/x86_64-windows/ntdll_test.exe ] || git submodule status 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^-'; }; then nohup tools/fetch_third_party.sh >/tmp/fetch_third_party.log 2>&1 & echo 'fetch_third_party: initializing all submodules and restoring the pinned third_party builds (qemu/wine/limine) from the release cache in the background — tail -f /tmp/fetch_third_party.log and wait for it (then run tools/setup_linux.sh for the apt toolchain) instead of building from source.'; fi

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.c|*.h|*.hpp|*.cpp|*.cc) CF="$(command -v clang-format || echo /opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang-format)"; [ -x "$CF" ] && "$CF" -i "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
